name: Road Narrows
spec: yellow diamond with black legend ROAD NARROWS

snippets.back: A ROAD NARROWS sign means the road ahead is narrower than the one you are on, and a PAVEMENT NARROWS sign means the paved surface ahead is narrower.

Most warning signs are yellow diamonds carrying a black border and black symbols or words, and the examples pictured include divided highway, divided highway ends, hill, slippery when wet, pedestrian crossing, and lane ends or road narrows.
A Road Narrows warning indicates a narrower road ahead that still leaves room to meet and pass.
Road Narrows from the right and Added Lane from the left describe different changes in available road space.
ROAD NARROWS refers to the whole road getting narrower, PAVEMENT NARROWS to the paved surface, and ONE LANE BRIDGE to a bridge too narrow to meet or pass.

result.summary: Meaning supported by AL stating road ahead is narrower and MT stating narrower road ahead. Spec supported by HI stating warning signs including road narrows are yellow diamonds with black border and black symbols or words.
